# Input Text

```tsx
import { InputText } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

A single-line text field. Mirrors the Figma Input Text component: State (Default / Hover / Active / Disabled / Read Only) × Filled × Error. Hover, Active and Filled follow the browser; Disabled, Read Only and Error come from props.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<InputText {...args} icon={getLeadingIcon({ showIcon, icon })} />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Input Text component: State (Default / Hover / Active / Disabled / Read Only) × Filled × Error. Hover, Active (focus) and Filled come from the browser; Disabled, Read Only and Error from props. Input Search and Input Password are built on top of this component.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`InputTextProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `className?` | `string` | Classes for the root, around the label, field and messages. |
| `icon?` | `IconSvgElement` | Leading 20px icon. |
| `prefix?` | `React.ReactNode` | Text before the value, like "R$" or "https://". |
| `action?` | `React.ReactNode` | Action Inset: trailing slot for an `InputAction`. |

## Types

`InputTextProps`

## Rules

- Import `InputText` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
